name: Coffee and Walnut Cake
author: The Wickham family
steps: Fold in flour alternately with milk and vanilla.
Fold alternately with walnuts into batter.
Pour into a buttered and floured 23cm cake tin.
Mix coffee with brandy and enough sugar to make a sweet syrup.
Transfer cooled cake to a platter with a raised edge and poured syrup on.
Repour on the syrup that is not absorbed.
Keep on doing this until all liquid is absorbed.

culture.text: Cake is a baker's confectionery made by combining flour with a liquid, a fat or both, and usually with a leavening agent. Cakes are usually baked, but can be griddled. In their oldest forms, cakes were modifications of bread, but cakes now cover a wide range of preparations that can be simple or elaborate and which share features with other desserts such as pastries, meringues, custards, and pies.
